overlay-celes: switch to Codec2.0 decoder for ARC++P Note that this is diverged from chipset-bsw for Celes due to b/64716375. Switch ARC++ HW decoder components from ARC.* (ArcCodec solution) to c2.vda.* (Codec2.0 solution) The stragedy of src_install is changed. Since for future desserts it should adopt the newest config (pic for now), we check nyc flag to adopt nyc config otherwise pic. And remove mnc one because it is already deprecated. Values in media_codecs_performance_c2.xml are directly copied from ArcCodec ones, in order to minimize the CTS failure count in the future. And in some time we will update with true values from C2 decoder anyway. BUG=b:78861844 TEST=emerge-celes -a arc-codec, they should still adopt nyc for now Change-Id: I8aa7b1c29d93354b9e394917c82860bda23ffb01 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1597891 Commit-Ready: Pin-chih Lin <johnylin@chromium.org> Tested-by: Pin-chih Lin <johnylin@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org>

There was a bug keeping these from being emitted in some cases; this CL is part of a cleanup of those. Since version_str is just a str, we can instead swap to using strncpy here. update_engine: add logs and metrics for libcurl errors curl_multi_perform may return code that is neither CURLM_OK or CURLM_CALL_MULTI_PERFORM. When error returns we log them in update_engine.log and send UMA metrics. When update_engine does not get http response code from libcurl, we log internal error code of the libcurl transfer for diagnosis. Chrome CL to add the metrics enum is here: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/1566150 BUG=chromium:927039 TEST=unittest Change-Id: Ie8ce9dc0a6ce5ff6ffc2ff9425b652d125518558 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1562172 Commit-Ready: Xiaochu Liu <xiaochu@chromium.org> Tested-by: Xiaochu Liu <xiaochu@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Xiaochu Liu <xiaochu@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Amin Hassani <ahassani@chromium.org>
